title: Ollama Native Chat API Request
description: Normalized request schema for POST /api/chat derived from Ollama's public API docs (github.com/ollama/ollama/blob/main/docs/api.md, rev 2026-08-11, release v0.32.11). Ollama publishes no OpenAPI or Discovery document, so this snapshot is hand-authored — the same situation as the Anthropic snapshot. Ollama's native API is unversioned; the 'v1' in the registry key is synthetic and exists only to fit zolem's provider:version key shape. The schema is deliberately permissive: it checks request structure, not the exhaustive field set, so fields added upstream after this snapshot never cause a spurious 400.

model.description: Model name as model[:tag]; the tag defaults to 'latest'.

messages.description: Full chat history; the server is stateless. Item shape is deliberately unconstrained so message-level fields (content, images, tool_calls, tool_name, thinking, tool_call_id) are all accepted without enumeration.

stream.description: Defaults to TRUE when absent, which is the opposite of the OpenAI chat-completions API.

format.description: Either the string "json" for loose JSON mode, or a JSON Schema object for grammar-constrained structured output.

options.description: Sampler and runner settings (num_ctx, num_predict, seed, temperature, top_k, top_p, stop, and so on). Unknown keys are silently ignored by Ollama itself.

keep_alive.description: Model residency duration: a Go duration string such as "10m", or a bare number interpreted as seconds.

think.description: Reasoning control. Tri-state: absent is distinct from false. String levels are low, medium, high, and max.

truncate.description: Truncate history when the rendered prompt exceeds the context window.

shift.description: Shift history at the context limit instead of erroring.
